description: Runs, errors and duration per stage and project, from the stage spans.

panels.title: Runs per hour
panels.description: Stage runs in the hour before each point, by stage and project.

targets.expr: sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h))

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Share of the stage runs in the hour before each point that failed, by stage and project.

targets.expr:
(
sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset 1h))
or
0 * sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h))
)
/
(sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h)) > 0)

panels.title: Duration p50
panels.description: p50 duration of the stage runs in the hour before each point, by stage and project.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h)))

panels.title: Duration p95
panels.description: p95 duration of the stage runs in the hour before each point, by stage and project.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, terragucci_stage, terragucci_project) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h, 0) or (terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_duration_seconds_bucket{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset 1h)))

panels.title: Runs by result
panels.description: Stage runs over the dashboard's range, by stage and how they ended.

targets.expr: sum by (terragucci_stage, terragucci_result) (clamp_min(terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} - terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset $__range, 0) or (terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} unless terragucci_spans_calls_total{terragucci_stage=~"$stage", terragucci_project=~"$project"} offset $__range))
